about: Central Saanich is a district municipality on the Saanich Peninsula north of Victoria, British Columbia, between Saanich and North Saanich. Farms, Brentwood Bay, and Saanichton villages sit among agricultural land rather than a continuous city. The ferry to Mill Bay leaves from Brentwood Bay. About 17,000 people live in Central Saanich.
seoSummary: Saanich Peninsula district municipality of farms and villages around Brentwood Bay—not a city.
